blurb: Euro Travel Coach creates personalized itineraries for independent travelers visiting various European destinations. They offer custom travel planning services with different tiers of service and also lead small group tours focused on food, wine, culture, and other interests. Their services include booking accommodations, activities, restaurants, and transportation, with detailed day-by-day itineraries provided via app or PDF.
extraNote: No hidden booking fees; flat planning fee model · Minimum payment for custom itineraries is for 10 days even if trip is shorter · Deposit for bespoke group tours is $500 refundable or deducted from final bill · Final payment due 90 days before travel for group tours · On-trip emergency support with 24 hour notice for Diamond tier
